caption:
Jhol Momos
one pan recipe | 1 hour recipe 

Macros:
C: 57 | F: 18 | P: 21
Calories: 467 per portion
Serves 2

this recipe is NOT traditional in any way so don’t hate, i made a version with basic pantry staples :) 

Ingredients:
16 momos, for 2 portions, either steamed or pan fried or fried
1.5 tbsp sesame seeds
8-10 garlic cloves
2 dried red chillies
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp ginger paste or a small piece of ginger
1 green chilli, this will add heat so be careful
3 tomatoes, diced
1 tsp peanut butter, add more for a better flavour, ive reduced it to fit my daily macros, peanut butter is VERY high in calories 
Handful of coriander leaves and 1/4 cup water to blend 
Method:
dry roast sesame seeds, set aside
in the same pan, add the sesame oil and add in garlic and red chilli, cook for a few minutes then add in onion, green chilli & ginger 
cook till onions are translucent
add in the tomatoes and a small cup of water and cook till your tomatoes go mushy 
switch off the gas and allow to cool before blending 
blend with coriander and half cup of water till you have a smooth gravy
cook your momos as desired 
put down 2 - 3 spoons of gravy, add the momos on top

garnish with coriander leaves, chilli oil, black and white sesame seeds and momo sauce that came with the packet :)
